references.text: The context explaining why Micah's neighbors gathered and pursued the Danites, leading to the confrontation in verse 23.
Micah's response explaining why he called out to them—they had taken the gods he had made and his priest.
A similar expression 'What is wrong with you?' (מַה־לְּךָ) is used when someone is asked about the cause of their distress or outcry.
Jacob asks a similar question to Laban about why he pursued him, paralleling the confrontation between Micah and the Danites.
David asks a similar question 'What is with you?' when confronting someone bringing news, the same type of rhetorical question.
